title: Data-driven modelling of tau pathology reveals distinct progressive supranuclear palsy subtypes.
authors: Cullinane, Patrick W; Parmera, Jacy Bezerra; Nelvagal, Hemanth; Curless, Toby; Chajed, Leckhna Paras; Wrigley, Sarah; Sifontes Valladares, Walter; Burrows, Maggie; Ebanks, Kirsten; Wu, Lesley; Binding, Lawrence P; Anton, Jaime; Revesz, Tamas; Real, Raquel; Vaughan, David P; Jabbari, Edwin; Morris, Huw R; Brandner, Sebastian; Young, Alexandra L; Hoti, Glen; Ma, Yangxinrui; Bechtawi, Mariam; Chiraki, Nancy; de Pablo-Fernandez, Eduardo; Lim, Yau Mun; Warner, Thomas T; Jaunmuktane, Zane
one_liner_zh: 该文用数据驱动建模研究tau蛋白病理在PSP中的传播亚型，对象为tau蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease characterized by the accumulation of misfolded 4-repeat tau within neurons and glial cells. There are limited longitudinal data on pathologically confirmed PSP patients with phenotypes other than classic Richardson's syndrome (RS) and the pathomechanisms responsible for the broad variability in clinical phenotype and progression are not well understood. An unresolved question in this context is whether distinct spatiotemporal patterns of tau pathology propagation exist within the clinicopathological spectrum of PSP. We included 241 consecutive, pathologically confirmed patients with PSP from the Queen Square Brain Bank for Neurological Disorders (2010-2022). Phenotyping was performed based on clinical features present within the first 3 years from symptom onset according to the Movement Disorder Society (MDS) criteria, and specific clinical features and disease milestones were recorded. Genotyping was performed using Illumina NeuroBooster and NeuroChip arrays and MAPT haplotype, APOE genotype, TRIM11 rs564309 and SLC2A13 rs2242367 single nucleotide polymorphism data were collated. Tissue sections from eight brain regions, mounted on glass slides, were immunostained for hyperphosphorylated tau and digitized using whole-slide scanning. Forty-one anatomical regions of interest were manually segmented, and total tau pathology burden was quantified using an automated, machine learning-based algorithm. The associations between survival and both clinicogenetic features and regional tau pathology burden were modelled using Cox regression and generalized linear models, respectively, and the Subtype and Stage Inference (SuStaIn) algorithm was used to identify subgroups with distinct progression patterns. We have identified: (i) several clinical predictors of survival in PSP and the relationship between regional tau pathology burden and survival; (ii) novel anatomical reference standards for the expected distribution of tau pathology across MDS-defined PSP phenotypes, including region-specific white matter involvement in patients with corticobasal syndrome and speech/language variants; (iii) associations potentially linking biological sex, MAPT haplotype and TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) co-pathology to clinical phenotype and regional tau pathology burden; (iv) patterns of covariance in regional tau pathology implicating inter-regional connectivity in tau spreading; and (v) three distinct spatiotemporal patterns of tau pathology progression: one characterized by initial involvement of subcortical grey matter followed by rostral spread to cortical regions and two characterized by early, simultaneous involvement of subcortical grey matter and cortical regions. Taken together, these results indicate that PSP clinicopathological heterogeneity is mediated by propagation of tau pathology along anatomically connected networks and via intrinsic regional susceptibility mechanisms, possibly influenced by sex, genetic factors and co-pathology.
abstract_zh: 进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）是一种异质性神经退行性疾病，其特征是错误折叠的4重复tau蛋白在神经元和胶质细胞中积聚。关于病理确诊的PSP患者中，除经典理查森综合征（RS）外其他表型的纵向数据有限，且导致临床表型和进展广泛变异的病理机制尚未充分阐明。在此背景下，一个未解问题是在PSP的临床病理谱系中是否存在不同的tau病理传播时空模式。我们纳入了来自皇后广场神经疾病脑库（2010-2022年）的241例连续病理确诊的PSP患者。根据运动障碍学会（MDS）标准，基于症状发作后前3年内出现的临床特征进行表型分型，并记录特定临床特征和疾病里程碑。使用Illumina NeuroBooster和NeuroChip芯片进行基因分型，并汇总MAPT单倍型、APOE基因型、TRIM11 rs564309和SLC2A13 rs2242367单核苷酸多态性数据。来自八个脑区的组织切片 mounted on glass slides，进行过度磷酸化tau免疫染色，并通过全切片扫描数字化。手动分割四十一个解剖感兴趣区域，使用基于机器学习的自动算法量化总tau病理负担。生存与临床遗传特征及区域tau病理负担之间的关联分别使用Cox回归和广义线性模型建模，并使用亚型和阶段推断（SuStaIn）算法识别具有不同进展模式的亚组。我们确定了：（i）PSP中生存的若干临床预测因子及区域tau病理负担与生存之间的关系；（ii）MDS定义的PSP表型中tau病理预期分布的新解剖参考标准，包括皮质基底综合征和言语/语言变异型患者中区域特异性白质受累；（iii）可能将生物性别、MAPT单倍型和TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）共病理与临床表型及区域tau病理负担关联起来的潜在关联；（iv）区域tau病理的协方差模式，暗示区域间连接在tau传播中的作用；以及（v）三种不同的tau病理进展时空模式：一种以皮质下灰质初始受累随后向头侧扩散至皮质区域为特征，另两种以皮质下灰质和皮质区域的早期同时受累为特征。综合来看，这些结果表明PSP的临床病理异质性由tau病理沿解剖连接网络的传播及内在区域易感机制介导，可能受性别、遗传因素和共病理影响。
